shape: a react-select degree menu whose choices word the answer differently (BSc vs Bachelor's Degree), so the AI picks by meaning, and the pick comes back after 26.7 s (the plan path's measured time)
why: 14 Nov 2026, #4298 (owner: "this filling is very slow and ineffective"): a held fill on a Greenhouse board form left the privacy and self-identify menus empty; the AI's picks took 18.4-26.7 s and the menu's 30 s real-time cap (extension/combo-click.js PATIENCE.hard) counted them, so each menu was given up as its answer arrived

control.guard: new case 14 Nov 2026: on origin/main the degree menu is given up (capped) when the 26.7 s pick arrives and stays empty; with the AI's time left out of the cap it is picked

sample: hand-made from education-menus-first-page-1 (the real vendored react-select), no real site
